data.text: ready sits at the edge of the 200ms budget: five runs gave 192/213/191/192/190 ms on the dirty tree at bc1b7f9 plus the uncommitted KAD-40/41/42 work. prime is 180-213 ms, board --json --summary 144-166 ms. Not a regression from a specific change — measured after the core was touched, as the rule asks. The journal has ~29 more events than when the budget was last measured, so the suspicion is fold cost growing with event count rather than any one command.
